id: # Ditto: copies an opponent's attack, does nothing without the Energy for it
# Mesprit: only with Uxie and Azelf on the Bench, a rule on the card rather than an Ability
# Unown: looking at a top card changes nothing; usable while a deck has a card
# Tapu Lele: 20 for each Energy on the chosen Pokémon
# Alcremie: Sweets Relay uses this game
# Gyarados: discard Benched {W} Pokémon one at a time, or stop

script: (seq (repeat (count my bench (type water)) (one-of (nothing) (seq (discard-pokemon (choose my bench (type water))) (bonus 40)))) (hit))

id: # Will: the first effect coin this turn is heads
# Slowking: up to 2 Tools from the hand, one at a time
# Boltund: the cheaper cost is a rule on the card rather than an Ability
# Mismagius: delayed damage that follows the Defending Pokémon
# Dugtrio: the top card is looked at before it's discarded
# Miltank: +30 for each use while it stays Active
# Gothitelle: an attach from the Energy Zone puts the Defending Pokémon to sleep
# Archeops: +20 on each hit of its next turn
# Golurk: the top 3 cards are looked at in place, then the deck is shuffled
# Prank Spinner: one card from both hands together
# May: as many Pokémon back as were found

script: (play (if (>= (deck-count my pokemon) 2) (seq (search 2 hand pokemon) (repeat 2 (hand-to-deck pokemon))) (then (search 1 hand pokemon) (hand-to-deck pokemon))))

id: # Ditto: copies a Benched non-ex attack, does nothing without the Energy for it
# Clemont's Backpack: +20 on every hit, Bench included
# Mega Mawile ex: +30 for each use while it stays Active
# Galarian Stunfisk: 40 to the new Active after a retreat
# Mega Kangaskhan ex: two hits, knock-outs in between
# Meowscarada ex: delayed damage to a spot
# Arboliva: heal a damaged Pokémon ex with Energy, then a random Energy goes

script: (activated (pick (choose my all ex damaged (has-energy 1)) (then (heal picked 60) (discard-random-energy picked 1))))

id: # Veluza: the cheaper cost is a rule on the card rather than an Ability
# Mew: a random attack from the opponent's hand and deck
# Maintenance: needs 2 other cards in the hand
# Budew: no Abilities while the Defending Pokémon stays Active
# Camerupt: one {R} Energy for each heads, while there is one
# Toxtricity: both parts need a knock-out last turn
# Iron Bundle ex: its first attack since coming into play
# Flutter Mane ex: its first attack since coming into play
# Quagsire: -1 is a random attack of the Defending Pokémon
# Vespiquen ex: may discard a Benched Basic {G} Pokémon

script: (seq (if (exists my bench basic (type grass)) (one-of (nothing) (seq (discard-pokemon (choose my bench basic (type grass))) (bonus 70)))) (hit))

id: # Pachirisu: the top card is looked at before it's discarded
# Hoopa: Tools into the deck before the damage
# Armaldo: a delayed Knock Out on a spot
# Delcatty: one Energy at a time, as often as there is Energy

script: (seq (hit) (repeat (energy (each my all)) (one-of (nothing) (pick (choose my all (has-energy 1)) (move-energy picked (choose my all not-picked) any 1)))))

id: # Drayden: one more random pick for Draco Meteor
